2607.06401.title: A Definition and Roadmap for World Models
2607.06401.paper_summary: World models -- internal simulators that learn the structure and dynamics of an environment -- have become one of the most actively debated concepts in AI. From model-based reinforcement learning and video generation to embodied robotics and ultimately, physical AI, researchers across AI subfields are building systems that they call "world models", yet there is no consensus on what a world model fundamentally is, what it should predict, or how it should be built. This perspective article provides a scientific definition of world models, discussions of their key technical aspects, and a staged roadmap for developing effective world models.
2607.06401.paper_summary_zh: 世界模型——學習環境結構和動態的內部模擬器——已成為人工智慧中最活躍討論的概念之一。從基於模型的強化學習和視頻生成到具身機器人學，最終到物理人工智慧，來自人工智慧各個子領域的研究者們正在構建他們所稱的「世界模型」，然而對於世界模型的基本定義、應該預測什麼以及應該如何構建，尚無共識。這篇觀點文章提供了世界模型的科學定義、關鍵技術方面的討論，以及開發有效世界模型的分階段路線圖。
